The '''Black Hole of Nakat''' was a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It gave rise to a common phrase that said: "trapped between the Black Hole of Nakat and the [[Magataran Maelstrom/Legends|Magataran Maelstrom]]."
